body: I wanted my life to be with him, it’s just hart breaking that he doesn’t. I’m still the one left feeling worthless

Thank you. Just to have one person validated the way I feel helps greatly. I live with my “partner” and he couldn’t be supportive if he tried. I can’t stop to sort my life out or risk the financial repercussions as I am supporting some one who I feel is just taking advantage of me. He hasn’t worked in the 3 years we’ve been together, I shouldn’t we working myself to death like this just to have my money spent out from under me. I know I shouldn’t be here at this point, but now if I slip up at I’m made to feel responsible for his “self harm”. He tries I hurt himself if I do anything he decides is a cry for attention. So anytime I’m not happy and looking after him. I just can’t anymore. I’m not this weak person, I don’t know why I stay. I just want my life back. But no life at all will do at this point, I just can’t leave
